column2: An Act to amend the Penal Code (Chapter 19)
BE it enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic Socialist
Republic of Sri Lanka as follows: -
1. This Act may be cited as the Penal Code (Amendment)
Act, No.     of 2025.
2. Section 82 of the Penal Code (Chapter 19) (hereinafter
referred to as the “principal enactment”) is hereby amended
by  the  insertion  immediately  before  the  illustration  to  that
section, of the following:-
“Fifthly  –  That  this  exception  shall  not  extend  to
the  imposing  of  corporal  punishment  in  respect  of
children.”.
3.  Section  308a  of  the  principal  enactment  is  hereby
amended  in  subsection  (1)  thereof,  by  the  substitution  for
the word “wilfully”, of the word “intentionally”.
4.  The following   new   section   is   hereby   inserted
immediately  after  section  308a  of  the  principal  enactment
and shall have effect as section 308b of that enactment: -
